evidence.observation: RC3-C4: key survives inserting a rule above another and inserting a fact above another.

concerns.recommendation: The criterion unconditionally claims the baseline key survives rule and fact insertion. However, per RC-D4 and O10, constraints without an ID use positional addresses and version 15 offending rows use positional fact indices, both of which change under insertion and break the key. Restrict RC3-C4 to apply only to rules with declared IDs and redesign the baseline key to avoid using positional fact indices, or the RC3 contract is demonstrably broken.
concerns.title: Baseline key stability criterion contradicts positional addressing and fact indices

evidence.observation: RC3-C3: base ill-formed exits 3 naming the base; an undecided alethic verdict in either run never yields "no new violations".

concerns.recommendation: The protection against falsely claiming "no new violations" when a run fails to judge is improperly narrowed to "alethic" verdicts. If a run fails to judge a deontic rule (or encounters a general unchecked verdict), it must not falsely claim "no new violations". Remove the "alethic" qualifier to ensure all unchecked verdicts block an unwarranted acceptance.
concerns.title: Baseline 'no new violations' protection improperly excludes deontic verdicts

concerns.recommendation: RC6 and the Milestone close phase lack measurable budgets (e.g., source/test line counts or time bounds) and clear stop conditions. The rubric explicitly mandates rejecting unbounded execution. Define explicit scope bounds and completion criteria for these phases.
concerns.title: Unbounded execution in RC6 and Milestone close

evidence.observation: O16 | declared-id-else-positional addressing already exists | ... ModelIndex.iter_constraints() (src/gnd/model_index.py:279)

concerns.recommendation: The reuse claim O16 incorrectly cites ModelIndex.iter_constraints() as an existing home for declared-id-else-positional addressing. As verified in src/gnd/model_index.py, this function yields only positional_constraint_ref and does not compute the declared address. Remove this citation from O16 or correct the claim.
concerns.title: False reuse claim regarding ModelIndex.iter_constraints()

response.summary: The plan contains blocking defects in the RC3 baseline contract: the stability of violation keys is compromised by positional addressing and fact indices, and the protection against 'no new violations' on failed judgements incorrectly excludes deontic constraints. Additionally, RC6 lacks required execution bounds.
